{"subject":"Congrats on Tekion Spend","body":"Hi,

Congratulations on the Tekion Spend launch this September. Being the exclusive provider for accounts and non-card money movement, built with Core Bank for automotive dealerships, is a meaningful vertical win. Seeing Coast, Gusto, and Ramp rely on Increase for more than $500B annualized is impressive too.

If useful, I'd love a 20-minute call to hear what you're learning from embedding banking into a vertical platform like Tekion. Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Priya"}
